note: Odd-m version; separation is 1/(qrR) - 1/Q (the 1/Q is the explicit loss from 2*alpha's O*(1/qQ) error) rather than the text's bare 1/(qrR).

snippet.text:
theorem frac_sep {q r r' b b' : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hr' : 1 ≤ r')
    (hrq : Nat.Coprime r q) (hr'q : Nat.Coprime r' q) (hb : b < r) (hb' : b' < r')
    (hbr : Nat.Coprime r b) (hb'r : Nat.Coprime r' b') {A : ℤ}
    (hne : ¬ ((q : ℤ) ∣ A ∧ r = r' ∧ b = b')) (u : ℝ) :
    1 / ((q : ℝ) * r * r') - |u| ≤
      |(A / q + b / r - b' / r' + u : ℝ) - round (A / q + b / r - b' / r' + u : ℝ)| := by

proof_context.conclusion: For q-coprime r, r' and reduced b/r, b'/r', the distance of A/q + b/r - b'/r' + u to the nearest integer is at least 1/(qrr') - |u| unless the angles coincide.
